record.reason: 一次資料abstractはLLMs are commonly trained with a learning rate (LR) warmup, followed by cosine decay to 10% of the maximum (10x decay). In a large-scale empirical study, we show that under an optimal peak LR, a simple linear decay-to-zeを対象とする。LLM推論の計算量、メモリ、latency、throughput、KV cache、quantization、offload、servingへの具体的な技術接続がないためunrelated。
record.title: Straight to Zero: Why Linearly Decaying the Learning Rate to Zero Works Best for LLMs
